output.summary: An evergreen shrub or small tree of cultivated west Pacific origin, created by Polynesians from parent species originating in Vanuatu and French Polynesia. Its typically red, five-petalled flowers have prominent orange-tipped structures, while cultivated forms range from white and yellow to blue and purple and may be double-flowered.
output.edibilityNote: Flowers are eaten in salads in the Pacific Islands and are dried for beverages in several countries.
